prompt: Who was the oldest Miss Universe titleholder at the time of her crowning, cheered as a triumph over ageism in a youth-obsessed world?
answer: Alejandra Marisa Rodríguez, a 60-year-old lawyer from La Plata, Argentina. She was crowned **Miss Universe Buenos Aires**—not the international Miss Universe title—and was celebrated as a challenge to ageism.
